title: 第17章 异常事件第18章 这个师兄有点问题
content_zh:
;;
苏白尘悄悄地跟着那鬼物在廊桥上走着。他当然没有继续用幻术让那鬼物以为自己也是个鬼，而是直接让自己看起来如同不存在。
幻阴八变太过全面了，在隐匿方面也能做得很好。
现在就是苏白尘哪怕是就站在这鬼物面前，它也发现不了。
而他跟着这个鬼物的目的也很简单，他想知道这鬼物究竟是怎么出来的！
因为他分明能够感觉到，廊桥以及旁边一排袡房的周围，结界依然存在。
甚至可以说，这个结界其实完全覆盖了整个海峡，理论上这一段就根本不该有鬼物出现才对。
他跟着走了一阵，忽然感觉不对劲，灵觉中有大量阴气聚集！
而阴气聚集的方向……
是旁边的一间袡房！
他悄然后退两步。
而下一刻，那袡房的门被一下推开，尚未来得及看清推门之人，就见一道漆黑的镰刀虚影一闪而过……
下一刻，那鬼物甚至连一丁点反应都没有，就被斩成了两段。
而那两段身躯落在地上就飞快地化作一摊黑水。
那黑水很快化开，成为很多驳杂的阴气，消散掉了！
阴冥咒术中的溃灭冥刀！
苏白尘小心地探头，就看到他的四师兄无念子面无表情地从里面走出来，看了看那一滩残留的污渍嫌弃地歪了歪嘴，又进屋关上了门。
苏白尘感觉有些不对劲，在原地愣了一会儿，随后转身回到了自己的袡房。
他在袡房里面没有做任何别的事情，就是琢磨刚才发生的一切。
首先他可以肯定，护宗结界没有问题，这鬼物要么遇到了他不知道的结界漏洞，要么就是被人带进来的。

而那鬼物看起来并不高级，至少被炼气初境的无念子师兄一招就秒了。
有一点他很在意……无念子师兄的出手未免也太果断了吧？
但杀伐果断也不是缺点，主要是苏白尘搞不明白幕后之人把那鬼物弄进来的动机是什么……
弄这么个小鬼在阴宗阴风关晃荡，这怎么看都有些缺心眼啊。
唯一不太对劲的地方还是在于无念子，但这种事他也没办法凭感觉来判断。
现在他的问题是，明天该怎么做呢？
是直接向玄阴真人汇报这件事？还是当做什么都不知道？
告知师父，这恐怕会打草惊蛇……那什么都不说，只当什么都没发现，然后暗中观察呢？
苏白尘斟酌了一下。
忽然间发现自己进入了一个误区。
那就是，以他所表现出来的灵觉能力，或者说以他当前境界的感应能力，一个鬼物在门前廊桥走过时是否应该发现异常？
答案是肯定的，甚至那个鬼物被他发现的时候根本就是在他窗前的崖壁上停留了有一段时间了。
那么按照这个逻辑，如果他表现得什么都不知道，是不是反而才打草惊蛇了呢？
苏白尘瞬间醒悟，而后想了一下，以自己幻术做成了一副脸色发白惊慌失措甚至气息都有些不稳的样子。就好像是在练功的时候忽然受到惊吓，岔气了。
他发现这幻术修炼了就是好，演戏什么的都可以更有操作了。
他准备第二天早上就去师父那里告状去。
然而超出他想象的是，天还未亮，玄阴真人反倒自己冲了过来！
他还没去告状呢！

Su Baichen quietly followed the ghost walking on the covered bridge. Of course, he did not continue to use illusions to make the ghost think that he was a ghost, but directly made it look like he did not exist.
The Eight Transformations of Huanyin are too comprehensive and can also do a good job in concealment.
Now even if Su Baichen stood in front of this ghost, it wouldn't be able to notice it.
And his purpose of following this ghost is also very simple. He wants to know how this ghost came out!
Because he could clearly feel that the barrier still existed around the covered bridge and the row of lofts next to it.
It can even be said that this barrier actually completely covers the entire strait. In theory, there should be no ghosts appearing in this section.
He followed for a while and suddenly felt something was wrong. A large amount of yin energy gathered in his spiritual sense!
And the direction in which the Yin Qi gathers...
It's a dormitory next door!
He quietly took two steps back.
The next moment, the door of the alms room was pushed open. Before he could see the person who pushed the door clearly, he saw a dark silhouette of a sickle flash past...
The next moment, the ghost didn't even react at all, and was chopped into two pieces.
The two body parts quickly turned into a puddle of black water as soon as they landed on the ground.
The black water quickly melted away and turned into a lot of mixed Yin Qi, which dissipated!
The Destroying Underworld Knife in the Yin Ming Curse!
Su Baichen carefully poked his head around and saw his fourth senior brother Wu Nianzi walking out of the room with an expressionless face. He looked at the remaining stains and twisted his mouth in disgust before entering the room and closing the door.
Su Baichen felt something was wrong and froze in place for a while, then turned and returned to his own room.
He didn't do anything else in his room, just ponder what had just happened.
First of all, he can be sure that there is no problem with the protective barrier. This ghost either encountered a loophole in the barrier that he didn't know about, or was brought in by someone.
And that ghost didn't look high-level, at least it was instantly killed by Brother Wu Nianzi, who was in the initial stage of Qi refining.
One thing he cares about... Senior Brother Wu Nianzi's attack was too decisive, right?
But being decisive in killing is not a shortcoming. The main reason is that Su Baichen can't figure out the motive of the person behind the scenes to bring that ghost in...
Having such a brat hanging around the Yin Feng Pass of the Yin Sect seems a bit heartless no matter how you look at it.
The only thing that wasn't right was Wu Nianzi, but he couldn't judge this kind of thing based on his feelings.
Now his question is, what to do tomorrow?
Report this matter directly to Master Xuanyin? Or do you pretend you don’t know anything?
Telling Master, I'm afraid this might alert others... So why don't you say anything, just pretend that you haven't discovered anything, and then observe in secret?
Su Baichen thought about it.
Suddenly I found that I had entered a misunderstanding.
That is, with the psychic ability he has shown, or in other words, with his current state of sensing ability, should a ghost notice something abnormal when it walks across the covered bridge in front of the door?
The answer is yes, even when he discovered the ghost, it had been staying on the cliff in front of his window for a while.
So according to this logic, if he acts like he doesn't know anything, does it mean that he has just alerted the enemy?
Su Baichen suddenly woke up, then thought for a moment, and used his illusion skills to make his face look pale, panicked, and even his breath was a little unstable. It was as if I was suddenly frightened while practicing Qigong and lost my breath.
He found that once he practiced this illusion, he got better, and he could become more effective in acting and other things.
He planned to go to Master to complain the next morning.
However, what was beyond his imagination was that before dawn, Master Xuanyin rushed over on his own!
He hasn't complained yet!
